examples.label: Enumerate 8.3 short names via the tilde scanner
Build a wordlist seeded from the leaked short name
Resolve full filenames with gobuster + extensions

notes: The tilde trick only leaks the first 6 chars of the 8.3 short name plus extension - you still have to brute the full name, which the generated wordlist + gobuster does. Works on unpatched IIS.

recommended.note: Broader web-app port sweep that surfaces IIS.

name: IIS - Tilde (8.3 Short Name) Enumeration
description: Abuses IIS 8.3 short-name disclosure to recover the first 6 characters of files/dirs (e.g. TRANSF~1.ASP). Build a wordlist from the prefix and brute-force the full name with gobuster.

defense.why_it_works: IIS on Windows uses the legacy 8.3 short filename convention. When IIS generates 404 errors for tilde (~) shortname requests, it returns different response codes/lengths for valid vs invalid prefixes, enabling inference of hidden filenames and directories.
defense.prerequisites: IIS server with 8.3 filename generation enabled (NTFS default). Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS. No WAF filtering tilde-based requests.
defense.impact: Reveals hidden files and directories: backup files, administrative scripts, upload directories, API endpoints not linked in the web application.
defense.detection: HTTP requests containing '~1' or '~' followed by digits in URL paths. IIS access log showing 404 variations for tilde paths at high rate.
defense.artifacts: IIS access log (tilde enumeration, varying response sizes) | WAF alert for IIS scanner pattern
defense.prevention: Disable 8.3 filename generation: fsutil 8dot3name set 1. Configure IIS Request Filtering to block tilde characters in URLs.
defense.misconfiguration: IIS running on Windows with 8.3 filename generation enabled (NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation = 0). No URL filtering to block tilde characters.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Windows -- 8.3 names enabled (default)
fsutil 8dot3name query C:
# NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation = 0 (vulnerable)
defense.secure_config:
# Disable 8.3 name creation
fsutil 8dot3name set 1

# IIS web.config -- block tilde
<requestFiltering>
  <denyUrlSequences>
    <add sequence="~" />
  </denyUrlSequences>
</requestFiltering>
